name: canai
description: CanAI — local AI content studio with an infinite canvas, editor, and node workflows powered by fal.ai

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.check: npm run check:help && npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix client run check
scripts.pretest: npm --prefix client exec -- tsx --test client/src/projects/activeProject.test.ts client/src/spaces/canvas/generationAvailability.test.ts client/src/spaces/canvas/konva/canvasMutations.test.ts && npm --prefix server exec -- tsx --test server/src/generationGate.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:i18n-codemod && node --test scripts/project-workspace.test.mjs scripts/generate-third-party.test.mjs scripts/generate-help-docs.test.mjs scripts/make-dist.test.mjs scripts/migrate-data.test.mjs scripts/update-secret-backup.test.mjs scripts/smoke-distribution.test.mjs scripts/local-edition.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-runtime.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-client.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-server.test.mjs scripts/public-release.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release-finalization.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release-windows.test.mjs scripts/scan-secrets.test.mjs scripts/install-gitleaks.test.mjs scripts/check-help.test.mjs && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.test:public-release: node --test scripts/project-workspace.test.mjs scripts/local-edition.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-runtime.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-client.test.mjs scripts/local-edition-server.test.mjs scripts/public-release.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release-finalization.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release.test.mjs scripts/prepare-public-release-windows.test.mjs scripts/scan-secrets.test.mjs scripts/install-gitleaks.test.mjs
scripts.test:public-release:syntax: node --check scripts/project-workspace.mjs && node --check scripts/export-public-source.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-public-release.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-public-release-guards.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-public-release-git.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-public-release-steps.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-public-release-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/public-release.mjs && node --check scripts/scan-secrets.mjs && node --check scripts/install-gitleaks.mjs
